summary.title: Online E-Commerce Ordering System
summary.description: Developed by Group RawRrr, this threat model analyzes the security of a web-based e-commerce system using the STRIDE methodology to identify threats and define appropriate mitigations.

threats.title: Stolen Customer Credentials
threats.mitigation: Implement Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and enforce strong password policy.

threats.title: Unauthorized Admin Login Attempt
threats.description: Provide a description for this threat
threats.mitigation: Apply Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and admin-only authorization.

threats.title: Manipulated Order Request
threats.description: Provide a description for this threat
threats.mitigation: Validate price and quantity on the server before processing orders.

threats.title: Customer Denies Payment Transaction
threats.description: A completed payment cannot be verified because audit logs are incomplete.
threats.mitigation: Store immutable audit logs with transaction ID and timestamp.

threats.title: API Flooding During Checkout
threats.description: Excessive requests overwhelm the REST API and prevent users from completing checkout.
threats.mitigation: Implement rate limiting and API throttling per IP address.

threats.title: Privilege Escalation to Administrator
threats.description: Provide a descripA normal customer gains administrator permissions due to improper authorization checks.tion for this threat
threats.mitigation: Verify user roles on every protected endpoint using JWT authorization.

threats.title: SQL Injection Against Database
threats.description: Provide a description for this threat
threats.mitigation: Use parameterized queries (Prepared Statements) and input validation.

threats.title: Sensitive Customer Data Exposure
threats.description: Personal information and payment records are exposed through unauthorized database access.
threats.mitigation: Encrypt sensitive data at rest using AES-256 and restrict database access.
